scope: Bounded code-layout sensitivity diagnosis, not performance selection. Reuse ordinary binaries, rebuild identical source with 64-byte function alignment. No algorithm/source patch.
timing_method: One process per case/arm/order on CPU 4, ABBA. Writes: one excluded pass then 12 measured passes. Reads: 12 fresh maps, first measured probe pass then validation, 8 untimed passes and 12 measured warm passes on each same map. Retain every sample.
allocator: tikv-jemallocator0.6.1, same allocator in separate counting build; requested bytes only.
gate: Original overwrite/unique-insert mean >=10% lower in both snapshot modes; all18write means improve in both orders; each of48read first-touch/warm cells pooled mean andp99 regression<=2%.

read_scope.same_code: Identical harness and remaining registry versions; baseline archery versus static as_ptr archery plus outlined triomphe shared clone branch.
read_scope.first_touch: For each fresh map, time the first512 probe queries before query-output validation; map construction touches nodes, no cache flush is implied. Then validate every query result outside timing.
read_scope.warm: After validation, execute8 untimed probe passes on this same live map, then12 measured probe passes. Retain both panels, every sample and per-epoch grouping.
read_scope.counting: Separate build;1 fresh map, first probe pass, same-map8 untimed passes and1 measured warm pass; writes1pass.
read_scope.gate: At least10% pooled original overwrite and unique-insert mean reduction in both snapshot modes; all18write means improve in both orders; every read first-touch AND warm pooled mean/p99 regress<=2%. No production promotion from this component result.

diagnostic_interpretation.replication: Original small-map warm GET hit must reproduce >5% mean regression in both ordinary orders before calling that phenomenon reproduced. Otherwise record an unstable observation and do not infer an alignment effect.
diagnostic_interpretation.alignment: Record every mean/p99 panel in both configurations and orders. A changed gap after alignment establishes sensitivity to this build-layout intervention only, not one instruction or a cache/branch cause. Compare instruction bodies, jump tables, call/relocation targets and output equivalence.
diagnostic_interpretation.cost: Original pinned unique insertion remains a separate diagnostic cell; report its mean/p99 with all samples. No allocation counter or profile instrumentation added.
diagnostic_interpretation.scope: No aggregate promotion verdict, no change to the original failed gate, no fresh database/Redis claim, no full matrix replay.
